title: stylebound.config.json
description: The one Stylebound config file, version 1. Every setting is optional. The CLI looks for it in the document's folder and then in each parent folder.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors.

profile.description: base: the OSS Writing Style Guide rules. strict-plain: the base rules plus the strict-plain overlay.

thresholds.description: Limits used by the strict-plain overlay.

instructionWords.description: Most words in an instruction sentence.

descriptionWords.description: Most words in a description sentence.

enable.description: Opt-in rules to turn on, by rule id.

ignore.description: Rules to switch off, by rule id. A rule cannot be in both enable and ignore.

glossary.description: Path to the project glossary, a CSV file, relative to this config file.

productNames.description: Your product names with their exact casing. The checker flags other casings.

brands.description: Third-party brand names with their exact casing. The checker flags other casings.
